traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Emotion meets power and intensity. Feelings run deep and extreme, with strong swings. The trine makes this a natural strength: Emotional depth and resilience that can be drawn on deliberately. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Feeling and power flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what feeling and power have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Emotional intensity: depth is an asset, volatility a liability.
shadow: The ease lets moodiness and over-need and control and obsession go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.
base: Emotional complexity can be faced more directly when intensity no longer threatens to take over the entire day.

readerCopy.body: Emotional complexity can be faced more directly when intensity no longer threatens to take over the entire day. When the Moon trines Pluto, feeling and depth reinforce each other, making resentment, fear, attachment, or desire easier to acknowledge without suppressing it or turning it into a crisis. Once the underlying truth is admitted, the next decision often becomes less mysterious. Honesty does not need extra drama to change how a situation is handled.
